annotations.title: Get betting picks for a match

description: Paid (2.00 USDC per call); free alternatives: get_track_record. For "what should I bet on?" in one Premier League, Championship, League 1 or League 2 match. Pass team names directly (match: "Forest v Chelsea"); no need to call list_fixtures first. tactica.'s official Betting Intelligence picks for one fixture, one per market (Result, Goals, Both Teams To Score), with selection, tier (Conviction, Core, Edge) and chance. Picks only: no odds. Use this when you want what to back on one match. Use get_top_five instead for the strongest picks across fixtures, or get_match_forecast for chances alone. No pick: says so. Read-only. 18+. Information, not betting or financial advice.

away.description: Optional, instead of fixtureId: the away team. Example: Chelsea

fixtureId.description: Optional: the tactica. fixture id, from list_fixtures; or pass the teams instead (home + away, or match). Letters, digits and . _ ~ -, up to 128 characters. Example: ce_0cefbf3ead8d4992af69b4f07f6c4113

home.description: Optional, instead of fixtureId: the home team as people say it. Example: Forest

match.description: Optional, instead of fixtureId: the match in words; the next meeting is used. Example: Forest v Chelsea

team.description: Optional, instead of fixtureId: one team; its next fixture is used. Example: Arsenal

name: get_betting_picks
title: Get betting picks for a match
